name: 53185 · Waterford, WI
findings: ZIP 53185 (Waterford) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53185 (Waterford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53185 (Waterford) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
